findings.title: Flex container makes the small-action button float ineffective, changing right alignment
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container, so its children no longer honor `float`. The existing `button { float: right; }` in this selector therefore no longer moves the button to the right edge; it will be laid out as the next flex item after `.small-action-desc`. No `margin-left: auto` or equivalent flex alignment was added, so the action button shifts left and the existing right-aligned layout regresses. Add `margin-left: auto` (or another flex ordering/alignment rule) to the button.

findings.title: Order on .extra-info-wrapper has no effect because it is not a flex item
findings.body: `order` only applies to direct flex items. The flexbox conversion in this PR targets `.d-header .contents` (`header.scss`), whose direct items are the title/panel elements; `.extra-info-wrapper` is nested inside the title, so this `order(2)` is inert and will not change header ordering. If this was meant to reorder the extra info, put the order on the actual direct flex item or make its parent a flex container.
